name: Mellum2 12B-A2.5B (JetBrains)

lineage.how_derived: pretrained base; Instruct and Thinking variants by SFT and RL

purpose: JetBrains states the base checkpoint is a long-context starting point for own fine-tuning, alignment or domain adaptation; the Instruct and Thinking variants exist for chat. Positioned for code completion in IDEs (research/52).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Card section "License" says "Released under the Apache 2.0 license"; the repository has no LICENSE file, so the text was not read.

architecture.attention: GQA 32 Q / 4 KV, sliding window 1024 alternating with full attention
architecture.why_this_design: The card states the mechanics, not reasons: 64 experts with 8 active, mixed sliding-window and full attention, and a long-context stage that re-maps RoPE frequencies on the global-attention layers only (layer-selective YaRN) to reach 131,072 tokens.

variants.notes: Instruct and Thinking repos with Q4_K_M GGUF listed (about 7 GB, estimate)

pc-12gb.notes: estimate from file size against the budget of docs/hardware (12 GB VRAM with 64 GB RAM); experts beyond VRAM stream from RAM, decode speed depends on that path

pc-16gb.notes: estimate from file size against the budget of docs/hardware (16 GB VRAM with 64 GB RAM (reference)); experts beyond VRAM stream from RAM, decode speed depends on that path

pc-24gb.notes: estimate from file size against the budget of docs/hardware (24 GB VRAM with 96 GB RAM); experts beyond VRAM stream from RAM, decode speed depends on that path

pc-32gb.notes: estimate from file size against the budget of docs/hardware (32 GB VRAM with 128 GB RAM); experts beyond VRAM stream from RAM, decode speed depends on that path

mac-16-24gb.notes: estimate from file size against the budget of docs/hardware (unified memory 16-24 GB, GPU share about 12 GB)

mac-32gb.notes: estimate from file size against the budget of docs/hardware (unified 32 GB, GPU share about 22 GB)

mac-64gb+.notes: estimate from file size against the budget of docs/hardware (unified 64 GB, GPU share about 52 GB)

engine_support.notes: GGUF repos exist for the Instruct variants; support not verified; FIM format not stated on the card page

strengths: Small active size (2.5 B) with 131K context
weaknesses: Base HumanEval 41.5 is low next to the 2026 coders: it is a completion base, not an agent
Language list not named on the card
soft.behavior: Base model: use the completions endpoint, not chat.
soft.maturity: JetBrains, established IDE maker; technical report published 2026-05-29.

tona_fit.reason: Candidate for editor autocomplete if FIM works; not an agent model.

sources.note: page text read through a summarizer (WebFetch)
